dirs.s: Social Space: Tauri 2 desktop app (React + Rust) that runs brands' social profiles: account setup, AI videos, posting, partner review; self-updates from main, managed by Ava.

scripts.s: Version bump (app-version.mjs) and the guarded release build (tauri-build.mjs).

src.s: React front end: App shell and views, feature components, *Service.ts wrappers around Tauri commands, use* hooks.

src-tauri.s: Rust back end: Tauri commands per feature, build.rs command list, capabilities, generated schemas.

src-tauri/src.s: One module per feature (instagram, review, queue, video_*, email, updater, hub...); lib.rs holds the Workspace and registers commands.

src/assistant.s: In-app assistant on a local Ollama model: chat panel, post suggestions, tools it can call.

src/pages.s: The top-level views: Overview, Brands/Accounts, Settings.

website.s: Partner review site (Firebase Hosting, project socialspace-review).

README.md.s: Partner install steps (clone + npm start) and dev commands

docs/signup-flows.md.s: Page-by-page sign-up flows for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube/Google and X with field selectors and who does each step

scripts/install.mjs.s: npm start: checks/installs Windows build tools via winget, pulls main, runs tauri:build, installs the NSIS setup silently and launches the app

src/BrandAccounts.tsx.s: A brand's Accounts tab: one card per profile (status, one next-step button, email/password, open steps) plus one-click Add <social> cards

src/Connections.tsx.s: Setup tab connections; exports useConnectFlow (connect/disconnect/one-time app setup) shared with BrandAccounts

src/signupFlows.ts.s: Each social's real sign-up steps (who does each: app fills or Nate); shown in the Create accounts side panel

src/socialIcons.ts.s: Inline SVG paths of the real Instagram/TikTok/YouTube/X logos used by BrandMark
